questions.knowledge_point: Multiplying Two Matrices When They Are Conformable
questions.worked_solution:
Here, $A$ is a $2\times 3$ matrix and $B$ is a $3\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $3$ columns in $A$ and $3$ rows in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{A}_{2\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 2}={AB}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute the unknown elements of $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 0 \\ 4 & 3 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -3 & 0 \\ 5 & -1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 0 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,5=2\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot (-3)+0\cdot 5 \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 0 \\ 4 & 3 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -3 & 0 \\ 5 & -1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 0 & 7\end{aligned}], &  & \,7=4\cdot 2+3\cdot 0+1\cdot (-1)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
AB=[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 0 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Finding an Entry of the Product of Two Matrices
questions.problem:
Let $K=MN.$ What is the value of ${k}_{12}$, if

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}5 & -4 \\ -3 & 2\end{aligned}],\,N=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 2 \\ -3 & -2 & -5\end{aligned}]?
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $1$st row in $M$ by the $2$nd column in $N$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{k}_{12} & =[\begin{aligned}5 & -4 \\ -3 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 2 \\ -3 & -2 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 & -4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =5\cdot (-1)+(-4)\cdot (-2) \\  & =-5+8 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

canonical_examples.worked_solution:
Here, the first factor is a $3 \times 1$ matrix and the second factor is a $1 \times 2$ matrix. 

There is $1$ column in the first matrix and $1$ row in the second matrix, so the product is well defined:

$$
\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{3} \times {\color{green}\fbox{1}} {\color{green}\checkmark} {\color{green}\fbox{1}} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2} = 
	\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{3} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2}
$$

Computing the product, we have

$$
\eqalign {
    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
       -1 \
 	0 \
        -2
    }
    \right\rbrack

    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
        2 & -5
    }
    \right\rbrack

	&= 

    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
        (-1)\cdot 2 & (-1)\cdot (-5) \
        0\cdot 2 & 0\cdot (-5)\
        (-2)\cdot 2 & (-2)\cdot (-5)
    }
    \right\rbrack \[5pt]

	&=

    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
       -2 & 5 \
       0 &  0 \
       -4 &  10 
    }
    \right\rbrack 
}
$$
